description: Look up a business you already know by name (e.g. "Whaley's Appliance"). Optional town + state or ZIP puts that area's matches first. Returns up to 10 matches with name, place and listing slug; use get_pro_profile on the slug for the full listing.

name.description: Business name, or the start of it (3+ letters)

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP: matches within about 60 miles

name: find_pro_by_name
title: Find a business by its name
